office_does: A King County Southeast Electoral District District Court judge hears and decides misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases and protection orders for a four-year term; in practice the discretion is in pretrial release, sentencing, protection orders and therapeutic-court supervision.
race_blurb: No incumbent is on the ballot (Judge Virginia Amato is not running) and the race skipped the primary. Heather Barker, a civil-practice attorney who has sat pro tem in this court since 2022, faces Joshua Harris, an attorney, Army veteran and security-company founder with no reported bench service.

candidates.summary: Civil-litigation firm owner and King County District Court pro tem since 2022, including Mental Health and Veterans Court calendars. She lists endorsements from the King County Democrats, the King County Police Officers Guild and local judges.
highlights: Judge pro tem in King County District Court since 2022, including Mental Health and Veterans Courts [S1][S3]
Owns Northwest Community Law, a civil practice; no prosecution or defense employment listed [S1][S3]
Says she will protect public safety "by carefully balancing accountability with rehabilitation" [S1]
Claims a KCBA Exceptionally Well Qualified rating that could not be checked (KCBA's 2026 page omits this race); JAJEC rated her Qualified [S1][S5][S8]
Endorsed by the King County Democrats (confirmed) and, per her statement, the King County Police Officers Guild [S9][S1]

experience.basis: About four years of pro tem service in this court, including therapeutic calendars, and a statement built on judicial experience and bench endorsements.

candidates.summary: Attorney, Army National Guard veteran and founder of a security company, whose practice covers employment, business, tax and administrative law. He reports pro tem training but no judicial service.
highlights: Served in the Washington Army National Guard; founded a King County-based security company [S1]
Practice in employment, business, tax and administrative law; no criminal practice stated [S1]
Says he completed pro tem judicial training; does not report serving as a judge [S1]
Lists no endorsements or bar ratings; campaign website did not load at access time [S1][S2]

experience.basis: No reported bench service against an opponent with four years pro tem in this court; runs on military, business and civil-practice background rather than a judicial record.
